description: This file contains the implementation of the NodeId class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages network node identifiers, including IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6), Unix domain sockets, netlink sockets, Bluetooth addresses, and raw socket information. The code includes methods for resolving hostnames, comparing node IDs, generating qualified names, and handling various socket types and protocols. It also features static utility functions for address validation and name generation for different socket types.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier, supporting IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, netlink, Bluetooth, and raw socket addresses. Provides methods for comparison, hostname resolution, address retrieval, and socket type identification.

methods.name: IsIPv4Address
methods.description: Checks if the given hostname string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: IsIPv6Address
methods.description: Checks if the given hostname string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Generates a broadcast address based on the current NodeId, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 types.
